  <section class="cv-sec">
    <h2 class="cv-h">Research interests</h2>
    <p>Smallholder productivity and input adoption; crop commercialization; food insecurity and vulnerability to shocks; applied microeconometrics with household panel data.</p>
  </section>

  <section class="cv-sec">
    <h2 class="cv-h">Experience</h2>
    <div class="cv-entry">
      <div class="cv-entry-head"><h3>Research Analyst, Laterite</h3><span class="cv-date">Aug 2024 &ndash; present</span></div>
      <p class="cv-org">Addis Ababa, Ethiopia</p>
      <p>Design surveys, build data systems and analyse data for research and evaluation studies in Ethiopia and elsewhere in Africa.</p>
      <ul>
        <li>Run the technical side of field studies: questionnaire design, sampling, SurveyCTO programming, data-quality monitoring during fieldwork, cleaning and analysis.</li>
        <li>Design monitoring, evaluation and learning frameworks, including theories of change, indicators and verification sampling.</li>
        <li>Work on household, business, health-facility and phone surveys, including panels of several thousand respondents, in agriculture, clean energy, health, nutrition, education and refugee livelihoods.</li>
        <li>Write R and Stata code for automated data pipelines and data-quality dashboards.</li>
        <li>Act as a technical contact for clients, co-write field reports and contribute to literature reviews.</li>
      </ul>
    </div>
